prompt.project_info: Create an 8K 3:4 studio fashion portrait of one approved adult woman in a deep-burgundy sequined jumpsuit against a matching maroon set.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with shoulder-length dark-brown hair in soft vintage waves, side-parted, calm poised expression, dark defined brows, deep-red lipstick, classic eye makeup, small gold dangling earrings, and realistic natural skin texture. She wears a deep-burgundy long-sleeved full-body jumpsuit with small reflective sequins or bead-like embellishments throughout.
composition_elements: Subject reclining diagonally across the deep-burgundy studio floor, head supported by one hand and the other arm resting naturally across the torso.
Full-body to three-quarter fashion framing with the sequin texture and vintage waves clearly visible.
Deep red or maroon seamless backdrop with subtle darker edges and a slightly lighter center.
Keep the monochromatic burgundy, dark-brown, and gold palette harmonious.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal studio key light with minimal harsh shadows, controlled highlights across face, hair, sequins, and fabric, low-to-medium contrast, and a luxurious editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-high-definition 8K photorealistic 3:4 portrait, 85mm lens at f/4, sharp subject focus, shallow depth of field, realistic sequin, fabric, hair, and skin texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
